messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: P1 - serving-degrade in us-east-3. Incident ID INC-8741. symptoms: elevated 5xxs from model-serving, slow tails > 2s. auto-alert: 3/5 hosts failing healthchecks.

pagerduty-bot: Notifying rotation: infra-sre -> sre-oncall (paging escalation in 2m) :rotating_light:

matt: ack. taking primary oncall. i see increased errors from shardpool-us-east-3:{model-embedder}. pulling logs now. anyone seeing capacity spikes?

anya: seeing CPU/GPU schedule backpressure on az3 nodes. telemetry shows queue depth jumped at 09:12 UTC. requests routed to us-east-3 are queuing -> slow response -> 5xx surge.

lee: confirmed. kvcache eviction rate spiked ~2.3x at 09:10, maybe due to a rolling job. checking recent deploys.

matt: rolling job? who rolled anything in us-east-3 in last 2 hours? @product-ops?

product-ops: no planned pushes. CI deploy bot shows no recent model pushes to that zone. last successful autoscaler tweak at 08:50 by infra-scripts.

anya: while we investigate root cause, recommend diverting new allocation for us-east-3 traffic to us-east-1 and eu-west-2. can run routing override for the cluster.

lee: +1 for diversion. also increase eviction grace on kvcache to reduce churn.

matt: executing routing override and raising kv grace. commands below. I'll apply canary for 10% first.

matt: ```
# divert 100 -> 10% canary to validate
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from":"us-east-3","to":[{"region":"us-east-1","weight":90},{"region":"eu-west-2","weight":10}],"reason":"P1 serving degrade INC-8741"}'
```

anya: logs after override show successful 10% shift. tails improved on canary nodes (p50/p95 down ~200/600ms). continue ramp.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-8741 acknowledged by matt. Escalation to L2 scheduled in 8m if not resolved.

sre-oncall: heads-up to SRE L2: please standby for deeper infra checks (nic stats, fabric errors).

lee: found root correlate: a cron job on us-east-3 triggered a mass checkpoint write that saturated IOPS for shards hosting kvstore. that induced kvcache thrash and caused backlog. job id: checkpoint-roll-2026-03-15-0910.

matt: disabling checkpoint job now and cleaning pending writes.```

matt: disabled the job and purged the checkpoint queue. kvcache eviction rate normalized after ~90s. increasing kv grace to 300s to stabilize.

anya: ramping traffic shift to full diversion: updated routing to 0% to us-east-3, weights now us-east-1 70 / eu-west-2 30. monitoring for errors.

product-ops: preparing customer impact statement: any regions with degraded experience should be included. preliminary: ~2% of requests affected, spike lasted ~6 minutes, tail latencies raised for a subset of customers (real-time features).

matt: writing a short incident note for customers. key points: transient IOPS saturation on us-east-3 caused kvcache churn -> increased 5xx and latency -> automated routing diverted traffic; failover completed, mitigation applied.

pagerduty-bot: Update posted to INC-8741: mitigation in place, traffic diverted, root cause: scheduled checkpoint job oversubscribing storage IOPS.

anya: will follow up with infra-scripts team to add rate limit to checkpoint job and preflight IOPS checks.

lee: post-incident action items: [1] add circuit-breaker to autoscaler for sudden queue growth, [2] enforce checkpoint rate-limiter, [3] add synthetic kvcache evict metric alarm, [4] run a tabletop for AZ failover playbook.

matt: handing primary to next oncall in 30m. @sre-oncall please take post-mortem lead. I'll leave detailed notes in incident doc. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: ack handoff. thanks team — I'll open the postmortem and assign owners. closing thread once notes are posted.

product-ops: Customer comms drafted, will route to support and account teams for review.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8741 status: mitigated -> routing diverted; monitoring for regressions. paging silenced.

matt: thanks all. closing on my side after postmortem created.
